journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: On Oct 7, I first came to college to see the campus and interact with students before deciding to join. I clicked a photo with Bhutada at KCIS, awkwardly unsure even about putting an arm around each other, yet it’s now one of my closest memories with my roomie!

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Summer after 2-2: so many things happened during this time: research started at CVIT, made friends with some amazing people, long late night walks, first college trip to Hampi, playing mafia in workspace and exploring all sports in all the empty courts on campus; spent the best time on campus.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Random walks around the campus: be it for getting some tea or ranting about assignments/courses, they have always been fun. "JC chalna hai?" and the discussions there. And later in 3rd and 4th year, playing cricket in CVIT with that one keyboard with broken space bar and smiley balls.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I don't think there has been a big change but a lot of deltas: be it my look with a big moustache and a beard or my dressing sense to the way I have managed time. I have learnt to juggle a lot of things at once  and the trust in myself that I can do it is what I believe the most important change in these years.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Plan has always been to pursue higher studies. Best would have been right after college, but things always don't work the way you want them to. So, a job for a year or two and then masters. I have always loved computer vision and would like to pursue something in this amazing field.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I remember roaming around the campus trying to find people I didn’t even know, randomly peeking at faces hoping one of them might become a potential friend. I walked all over the campus alone and just searching for the best place to sit in the workspace.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Those random workspace nights where I thought of doing something meaningful but ended up discussing random ideas, discussing politics, philosophy and watching movies in blue room .

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: My place in the SERC Lab and my workspace Spot.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Nothing, Just realized that you can't do everything.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Eat, Code, Sleep

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I still remember my first day on campus. Around 10 am, I arrived with my dad, nervous and excited. journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: My best campus memory has to be 3rd year felicty, Handling events as a TGC club coord as well as it was when our grp was at its peak, i still remember the late nights fun in tgc warehouse, random talks, full of chaos, barely any sleep, dancing at DJ and so much more. easily the best time of my life.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: the thing i will miss the most is probably the spontaneous plans in our grp, the random mafia nights, turf nights, gaming sessions, renting out scooties, random dinner outing and so much more, but most importantly i will miss the people with whom this events were fun. (shoutout to "ASS of IIIT").

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Biggest change since first year would probably be how much more confident and independent I’ve become. I came to college as a pretty confused and introverted person, not really knowing where I fit in. Over the years, through clubs, events, friendships, late-night dlf walks/talks, failures, and memories, I slowly grew into someone who can handle pressure, responsibilities, and chaos much better. IIITH honestly changed me a lot, and I think for the better.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Corporate life/job but apart from academic, I am not entirely sure yet, but hopefully something exciting. I want to keep building cool things, work on projects I genuinely enjoy, meet amazing people, and make memories outside college too. For now, just trying to figure life out one step at a time and see where it takes me.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Somehow I stayed close with the people whom I met on the very first day, be it my roommate, the white goggles-wearing attitude wala kid, or the random dude I met at amphi during orientation, they all became really good friends of mine, whom I'll cherish forever.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: I've always loved accessing restricted areas, especially with my group of non-daring friends and dragging them along with me in these adventures. My favourite memory is very recent, when I was about to seriously injure myself just a day before the last endsems.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: The people, for sure. Random interactions with long-lost friends, catching up with them at vc/jc., the late night walks, the bitching and gossip sessions will all be dearly missed.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I have grown to be a much more social person than I initially was. Given that I was scared to approach new people, I can now confidently strike up conversations with strangers.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: The immediate goal is to wrap up my thesis asap and get out of here. I'll probably be enjoying my life as a corporate slave for the foreseeable future.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Got to meet a lot of great people on the first day itself. Probably the most social day of my campus life, met people, got some friends, interaction with seniors, north mess food for the first time. A great day overall!

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: 6th April 2024, 8th October 2025 (would love to keep the memory to myself) and the Pondicherry and Ooty trip with the group forms some of my best college memories.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: A lot of things-late night walks, pre-exam stress and completing syllabus all in a day. Sitting together, playing games, watching matches.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Personally, my weight! Have lost a lot of weight since the first year but the biggest change would be in my personality because of the great company I have had here. Learnt a lot and enjoyed a lot!

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Completing MS grad requirements :<

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Everyone I met that day were amazing, and I got to meet people I'd been talking to online for weeks. They all were quite like and dislike how I imagined them to be, and I even knew one person had to be Sairam just cause of the way he stood.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Too many to choose one. Interbatch football, NYE dinners, laser tag, stargazing, Pondicherry, Goa, Mumbai, barbeque and pool, escape rooms, movies and anime in the blue room, video games and football together, FIFA world cup, all the random mess and canteen visits, and all the late night walks.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Running into my friends everyday at every possible moment while just going about my day. Yapping while walking around the empty roads at night. Birthdays at JC. Sitting in each other's room in Bakul.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Thanks to my friends I can smile, I can hug, I can kiss, and I can love and be loved. Plus I now have long hair, hate Google, and love CS more than I did when I started.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Lots to do. Have so many projects I want to start (keep an eye out on my Github ;), places I want to visit, and friends who I want to have loads of fun with. I really want to help invoke change, politically, socially, and technologically so I won't be surprised to see myself getting involved in politics, teaching, or anything else that I believe would help achieve that.

name: Ansh Chablani

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I came to the campus on 27th October, 2022 with my parents. It was night time and we were walking down the streets IIIT held previously, met some seniors and for the very first time experienced how spicy Hyderabad food can get when we had dinner at Tantra. Also had my first JC drink that day.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Can't point out to one particular instance but there were moments that happened for the very first time in my life, the importance of which I understood after a while. Meeting someone special, the late night talks that stretched until morning, the unplanned class fun and what not.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: I will miss the fun and joy a classroom environment brings and how hilarious some moments become.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I do believe I have transformed completely when it comes to how I interact with people and situations. I might have nearly the same intellectual capabilities as I had before coming here but now I react to worldly situations differently and have a changed demeanour (tho I still enjoy having moments that are fun). Responses are now calmer and so is life. There is now a sense of calm which I didn't have previously.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Will take life as it comes by, make most of it and enjoy it to the fullest!

name: Ansh Jalpenkumar Shah
tagline: After all, every ending begins something more beautiful

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: It was an exciting day, my first time in the city and with so many new faces. It definitely felt different being in a hostel. I remember meeting so many people that I forgot names for the first few days and just smiled 🤣. The new environment felt different, but I was always excited to explore it.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Among all the ones where we had a blast, the best ones had been the first few years of Felicity. Dancing to some random AFTER PARTY DJs, to Hindi and Telugu songs, Random Garba that starts from idk where, Participating in some cool events and having lots and lots of amazing food, who wants more!

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: The most fun part about the journey was the unplanned activities at most weird times that we did over the years, including going around the campus and discussing day's most bizzare things we saw, unfiltered comments on anyone, late night deep discussions into politics and plans to go somewhere NICE

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: The biggest one in my own self was how I approach towards new opportunities. The way I used to be more careful before, now I have found out that getting the ball rolling in very important in any aspect of life and perfection comes with time and patience only. Seeking help is the biggest way one can quickly evolve and excel. \nI've also seen a huge change in the way I became a more collaborative person than before. Discussing things with friends and peers help get fresh perspective to the solution

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I'm looking forward to working at Goldman Sachs. I want to travel to a lot of places in India and beyond! Will be with a lot of current good friends and discover many more on the way 💗. Looking forward to an exciting time of life, lots of interesting things to learn and enjoy.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: It was a very weird yet exciting feeling. The first time I saw bakul was quite overwhelming, so many unknown faces everywhere. journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: hanging out with friends late in the night. talking cricket for hours and screwing up exams just to watch every single ball of even a test match. making streaks of daily 5am niloufer etc is something that i dont think i can dk ever again :(

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: The thing I will most is definitely the late night walks in campus with friends. I dont know after college ends, when and where else can I just walk so freely at 3 in the night. Watching RCB or india matches together would be another thing that I'll definitely miss.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I think I have improved a lot in how I handle situations now. Things dont bother me as much as they might have 4 years ago. I am far less judgmental of things/people now and do not necessarily stereotype them.   Also I think I have realised that I need to interact more with people, something which I think I missed out in college and would like to change going further. And maybe my fashion sense has improved !?

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: looking forward to the job in hand. hope to earn some good money so that i can fund my expensive hobbies lol. hoping to stay in touch with all these idiots.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I met my roommate Awasthi, and my neighbor Aniketrax, we chilled for a bit, attended various sessions on how good college life would be and how lucky we were to be there. Both of those turned out true but for reasons completely different from those i had expected.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: When i go through my head, no singular memory actually comes to mind. Countless good memories about college flood me whenever i think of this question. Gaming Nights, Exam All-Nighters, Felicity Parties, Football Matches, Insane Mess Trips all hold an equal place in my mind when it comes to this.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Strange way to put it but - The Nights. Be it a Gaming Night, an Exam Night, Turf Night, Party Night, Movie Night, Foodie Night, Walk Night, Talk Night, whatever. The Nights in college always were so unexpected as what I would do, yet so fulfilling and I always enjoyed it too much with my brothers!

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Throughout college, I have realized that thinking before doing anything - talking, making a decision, planning an action; is extremely vital. No good comes from reckless decisions and actions - plenty of which I have had made in my first year. i strive to now always weigh the possibilities of each decision i make, or anything i do before it is done and i can confidently say it has helped me a lot in my college life.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I never was a man with a plan. I have always never wanted luxuries but to live a simple, sedentary life, and have never been too much of a person who wants greatness. I just want to be successful to be able to give back to others, to those in need and of course to those who have helped in my bad times.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I still remember the first day, the campus was completely packed with everyone doing documentation work. We spent the whole day roaming around from Himalaya to Bakul and then Amphi. The excitement of starting a new journey and the whole campus vibe made the day really special.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: There are so many memories that I honestly can’t pick one. The FC election campaigning, the first day on campus, Freshers’ Night, late-night campus walks, FIFA'22 WC screenings, and the list just goes on. I think the best part was never an event, but all the people that made things special.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: It’ll definitely be the people with whom I spent my 4 years. I met a lot of people because of FC and SPC work, and even those small interactions meant a lot.  In the end, it’s all about the people with whom I spent most of my time, and I’m definitely going to miss all these small moments.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I won’t say I was nervous, but before coming to college I had never really taken much responsibility or managed things at bigger level. College completely changed that for me. I took up multiple roles like TGC coord, FC, and SPC, and all these roles gave me very different experiences. Some involved managing bigger teams, some required more on-ground work, while others involved dealing with corporates. All these experiences changed my perspective and helped me grow into a more responsible person.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I’ll be starting a new journey into the corporate world. I interned at Walmart and received a PPO, and I’m really excited to join Walmart and begin this new phase. I’ve always wanted to learn new things and create an impact wherever I go, and I’m looking forward to all the experiences and challenges ahead.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: College felt huge;walk from South Mess to Himalaya was exhausting. New faces, confused minds, hopeful thoughts, homesick hearts. Days were hectic, yet I hoped for the best. journal.answer: I think I learnt the most in my 3rd and 4th years. 3rd year taught that making others happy makes me feel happy. Small wins make me and my team proud! journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Vibrant atmosphere, every face is filled with curiosity and excitement. Met my roomie, got the hostel essentials, roaming here and there very excitedly. The feeling was nice, not knowing how the college life was going to shape us permanently.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Too many! I have gotten really great memories with my friends, E-Cell, Felicity, juniors, many more.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: The hostel life. All your friends at a place, go to them whenever you want, sit wherever you like, do whatever tf that itches you. That kind of support system won’t ever be this much accessible again. Later it’s all schedules and “let’s catch up sometime,” which rarely happens easily.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: How I view about friendships and human connection changed a lot. Breaking from stereotypes, learned to love more, laugh more, do more.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: No plans! Let's see where life takes us

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: As someone who is afraid to face anything unfamiliar, I felt like I was dropped into the middle of a story I hadn’t read. I remember holding onto my bag strap, my phone, and my own thoughts, trying not to look lost. Then I met my roommate and the rest is....

journal.answer: SBI Stairs.....Parijat A 217....BBC.....Nilgiri.....Wkscpc

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Kadamb Biriyani

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: The biggest change since first year has been learning how to balance different parts of life...friends, family, academics, and the things I enjoy outside all of it. I’ve also learned how to handle stress better and, more importantly, how to prioritize myself without feeling guilty for it. I still have difficult days, but I’ve become much better at protecting my peace and appreciating the people and moments that matter to me.

name: Chirag Dhamija
tagline: Waj Geya Alarm Sawer Ho Gayi Kamm Chhoot Jaana E Je Der Ho Gayi

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I was feeling very nervous as I was going to start a new journey in a totally different city and atmosphere. TBH I was scared that I selected a wrong career and I won't fit in here, but now 4 years down the line I feel really confident and I am much of an extrovert now.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: There is not one but many. Like playing various games like kaabo, mafia, COD etc till 4 AM in Bakul, Seeing brainrot movies with my mates, Late Night Turfs , Preparing for BC dances, JC meetups after a deadline, Securing an internship and seeing some of my friends finally getting placed.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: I wil miss my friends and this college the most. Turfs, campus walk, and Mafia with entire "Ass of IIIT" are some of the things that I wish I could do forever. Those random and instant plans, discussion on brainrot topics, grades ka RR, companies ka CTC are few things that I will never forget.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: In my first year, I was someone who found it difficult to make friends. Yes, I did make some wrong friends, but those experiences taught me a lot about life. I was a very introverted person when I started college. However, after these incredible four years, I have become a completely different person. I have learned how to build meaningful friendships and have become much more extroverted in nature.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I want to gain industry experience for a few years and keep improving myself over time. I will also try my best to pursue my hobbies alongside work. Later in life, I want to gradually shift toward the managerial side.\n

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Was excited for this new phase, but also felt a bit chaotic. Made a couple of friends, and explored the campus.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Can’t pick just one… every moment is a memory, and each one is just as special.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Each and every thing.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: A lot has changed. Maybe the biggest change is that - life now brings something new each day, and I find myself evolving and changing constantly, along the way.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer:

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer:
People usually wanna drag others down on public Social Media platforms. Lets avoid giving them opportunities on a platter.

I started saving my opinions for those who care & places where it can matter genuinely.

Stopped giving 2 shits about gossips or public opinions about me. 
Love & respect those extremely close to me and will always care about what they think about me.
Started taking feedbacks positively as chance to improve myself (cliche, but it did happen.)
4 years of college brought that

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer:
Up & Ahead!! There is no looking back ever anyways!

Ive seen my ups & tough times through these life-&-personality-altering 4 years of College, have emerged with extremely successful new beginning to the next phase, am doing what I love doing, have found stability & comfort in my passions, progressed with continuous efforts in every aspect.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Started the day with mix of emotions, but within hours everything felt overwhelming new faces, huge buildings, & confusing timetables . At one point, the question was How are 4 years going to pass here? \nFunny how the same place later became part of best memories & now the last day has already come.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Not one single moment — every little things : last-minute submissions, random talks and walks at nights ,classes, fest nights, and my first dance performance with friends on stage during college life.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Spending time with friends — going out, laughing over random things, playing around without worrying about anything, and turning ordinary days into the happiest memories.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: A complete transformation — from being scared and confused in the beginning to becoming stronger, more confident, and learning how to manage everything while staying positive and moving forward happily.

journal.question: What next?

name: Debangan Mishra
tagline: There is no right answer for getting along. Different people require different answers.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Ooh very awkward, just like how all new beginnings are. Some people have drifted away, but the others from my first day have cemented in my soul. It was an absolute rush with unending introductions, and the anticipation for a new beginning. It all turned out great after all!

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: No single memory as such, but rather a collection of many moments spent with friends. From playing uno in the late night and getting a merciless +24, gossip sessions with chai in hands, pondering about life under the stars, and dancing during cult night.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: The company! We will all go separate ways, and physical proximity will increase. But more importantly, even the mental proximity reduces. Let's pledge to stay as connected as we can even in the future.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I have definitely grown so much more confident in talking to people. I was a loner before coming to college, but IIIT changed me for the better. I feel that I have made friends and memories that will last a lifetime, if not more :3

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Honestly, God knows! I have no clue what happens in my life, and I just let things happen to me on the flow. Let's see?\nI just know that whatever will happen, I will take it head on.

journal.answer: Sitting late nights in HSRC, those random walks at nights, studying in the library just before exams, 305, 4am bhavani bondas, sleeping with beds in the workspace, first year house party, winning cult night, gossipping, paris, dance practices, the final batch trip the list could just go on and on!!

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I feel like I've become eternally nocturnal! I've learnt insane multi-tasking skills through everything. One of my biggest life lessons was definitely learning everything that can go wrong will go wrong is real, and how to deal with that as well! A lot changed honestly I think now I can better control my emotions, express them, talk to people and how I present my self. The person who walked into this college and the person who is figuring out his journey now are definitely two different people.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I honestly don't know (will go with the flow)... but with lots of FUN FUN FUN along the way, just wanna see the world maybe an MBA abroad, go around meet lots of new people, eat new types of food!! Maybe more trips with my friends. A solo trip across India. Hope all my friends get married soon and I get to dance at their wedding (I wanna keep dancing and making reels), just keep my hobbies alive. Some good money, a nice job, a fridge with unlimited supply of icecream and warm waffles!:)

name: Devansh Kantesaria
tagline: Whatever happens in life, happens for good!

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I cam alone, in flight, at night, in an unknown city!! Took a bus from airport, and  dropped off near gachibowli circle, where, a kind mtech gentlemen joined me, took me to college, where, I somehow managed to get a room that night, and a mattress. Then, went to south mess and had dosa free of cost!

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Hardcoding Cpro problem soln in ug1, 4-2 2-4 SP issue in ug2, becoming speaker and gensec in ug3, meeting the governor, getting google intern in ug4.  But above all are those random carefree convos I had with friends, which were the most fun times, and nothing can replace those core memories!!

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: My friends for sure!! Made so many of them over the years, many friend groups!! I will also miss my many lab friends that I made. Will surely miss the late night random gossips that I had with friends, the convos which were carefree, no responsibilities in life, just enjoying the time!!

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I never Imagined I would be the gensec of the college, and lead all students! From an introvert guy in school, with lot of ambitions, to fulfilling them after coming to college, I surely came a long way! I never imagined i would make life long friendships here, or, publish a research paper!!

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Currently interning at google, hopefully get placed in a good company, and, switch to a better career path down the line, like management or business, but many tough calls to take. Feels like life has just started, and so have the endless responsibilities, but, I am ready to tackle them, no many how difficult they may be!

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: My first day on campus felt like an emotional roller coaster. My parents were sad about leaving me at the hostel, while I was excited, nervous, and questioning my life choices every 5 minutes. (the perfect chaotic start to college life).

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Honestly, meeting my boyfriend. Somewhere between classes, assignments, stress, and random campus walks, he became my favorite part of college life and the best memory I’m taking with me from campus.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: The freedom of randomly knocking on a friend’s door at midnight, campus walks after stressful days, and knowing my favorite people were always just a few rooms away.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Maybe me?

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Honestly IDK

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: My first day was on 28th Oct 2022, I was very overwhelmed seeing the people around and didn't know who to talk to. My roomate Harsh knew some people from his city who became my friends as well. I remember meeting so many people, introducing, and attending apex meets! It was so new and fun!

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Every memory doing bakchodi with my friends, random campus walks, BC dance!! and just hostel life is my best memory. Going out, exploring new places in Hyderabad, and then coming back late night, with the skyline view at Durgam Cheruvu, or late night football in turf was really awesome!!

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: My friends, the freedom to do whatever I want and whenever I want to. Not being constrained to a fixed schedule of sleeping early waking early, and having to spend X amount of time working compulsorily. This was my first time being independent and the flexibility that comes with it.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Maturity. From a kid to a man (Hopefully), learning and accepting the harsh realities of life, separating from people, becoming distant, finding new friends, interests, loosing everything, gaining a lot, being betrayed, to being loved. I have went through a plethora of things here, which has changed my POV of life deeply. Handling a lot of stress, anxiery and sadness while still refusing to give up is something which has made me stronger, more confident and appreciate life more!

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Living my life to the fullest. These 4 years have been really fun and I really hope that corporate or job in general doesnt kill it. While its hard to match the kind of memories we made here, I still would want to keep doing something which would make me feel that I am utlising the time I have here on earth and not just finishing up my years. I want to pursue my existing hobbies as well as find new ones, work and do something impactful, be there for my people and belong somewhere I can call home

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: On my first day on campus, I was super nervous and overwhelmed by the huge crowd. Seniors helping with luggage and hostel stuff made things less scary. The best part was making friends on Day 1 itself, and they’re still some of my closest people today.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Some of my best campus memories are the Pondy trip with friends, batch trip, dance practice sessions,Felicity, and all the campus fest events. Honestly, every time I’m with my friends, it turns into a new memory. My last semester was truly a blast and definitely the best semester of my college life.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: I’ll miss my friends the most . This semester, we lived every moment knowing it was our last together - endless gossip sessions, trips, outings and so many pictures that even my phone storage gave up . I’ll truly miss the chaos,laughter and memories we created together.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I’ve grown a lot, both personally and professionally, over these four years. Looking back, I can honestly say my personality has changed in many ways. The placement season especially taught me resilience, patience, and how to handle pressure. I feel much more mature, confident, and ready to face whatever life throws at me.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Excited for the next chapter of life. I’ll carry these memories with me while creating many more along the way. Hoping to grow, achieve meaningful things, and become someone my younger self would be proud of. No matter where life takes me, a part of me will always stay connected to this journey and the people I met here.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I started my first day feeling very nervous and homesick, but meeting so many wonderful people changed everything. Looking back, the entire experience has been absolutely amazing.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Lots of memories...can't pick one.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Living just a door away from my friends, entering their rooms anytime, campus walks, picking outfits for each other, going out, campus walks... I'll miss my friends the most.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: A lot has changed in my life since my first year. I think the biggest change is that I have become a much quieter and more private person than I used to be.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Looking forward to happiness, positivity, and a new set of experiences! Still have one more year left on campus to wrap up my MS grad requirements.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I remember walking onto campus in a mixed state of being completely nervous and excited at the same time. Started talking to people during induction events in the first few days. Little did I realize then that the friends I made in those first few days would end up lasting me a lifetime of memories.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: All the impromptu stuff like tt, tennis, cycling, random banter, pranks, late-night walks. Just hanging out with friends around campus and the spontaneous chaos of it all made the campus feel like more than just a college.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: My friends. They’re the ones who made the last four years feel like home.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I’ve definitely grown a lot in confidence. I feel much more natural and excited about trying out new things now, all thanks to my friends for constantly pushing me out of my comfort zone.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Genuinely no idea. I’m just taking it as it comes, but I definitely want to stay in touch with everyone. I’m really hoping for the best for all my friends and want to see everyone do well in whatever comes next.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: The best campus memories are associated with getting internships and placements of me and my friends. I vividly remember the day I got my Google internship; we all celebrated hard, went to Davids. Also, when PPO came, everyone was congratulating and hugging me.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: It would definitely be whole group talking and laughing together. Whether it's on late-night walks or while sitting on BBC/Mess, or bugging in Class :P. I will crave a room full of friens and they are just talking about random stuff, teasing each other, and just unlimited laughter.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I think the biggest change since first year was becoming comfortable with who I am. I was shy, underconfident, and often overthinking about marks, friendships, fitting in, and how people saw me. Over time, friendships became deeper, conversations became more genuine, and the fear of missing out slowly disappeared. Somewhere along these years, I became more expressive, confident, and peaceful within myself. Looking back, I’m grateful for the person I slowly grew into.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer:
Who has really seen tomorrow? But for now, I’ll probably be stepping into the corporate world :(
Maybe a few years down the line, I’ll either go for an MBA or start something of my own.
But one thing I am sure of: I’ll desperately wait for reunions, random trips, and just a little more time together.

Excited and a little nervous to see how the future unfolds!

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: There are honestly too many memories to choose from. All the late-night walks, random hostel conversations, trips, dance practices, project chaos, and just sitting with friends doing nothing became the best parts of college life.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Definitely the people and the accessibility to them. Being able to randomly meet friends at odd hours, going on walks, late-night talks, spending time with R😊, and always having someone around made this place feel like home. journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Probably coming out of my small bubble and becoming more open to experiences and people. These 4 years taught me how to handle situations and emotions better. journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I was excited and confused on my first day of college. Everything felt new, and I went on a campus tour with apex team and had a lot of meetings with professors and our most helpful and beloved seniors. Rest of the day was mostly spent making new friends, and relaxing in the hostel room.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: There are many best memories. Random night walking on campus with friends after dinner and during midnight and completing the assignments and projects mostly just before the deadline. Playing pool, cards, and cricket. Celebrating birthdays at midnight was some of the best memory on campus.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: My Room - 128. I spent all 4 years in the same room with akshat (1 yr) and abhishek (3 yrs). I will miss all my friends and hostel life. Spending time and making some good memories with friends throughout my years of college life in the same room and with same neighbors atidipt and ishan awasthi.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Since my first year, I have become more confident and focused. College taught me how to handle responsibilities, challenges, and growth together. i have learned and experienced a lot from people of this campus. The academic structure and the people on campus taught me how to manage time wisely and maintain the balance between studies, other activities, and personal growth all together.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Next comes a new journey filled with opportunities, challenges, learning, and self-growth. I will be joining the corporate world and will be looking forward to building my career and achieving my goals, and I hope to carry all these unforgettable college memories with me forever. I will be experiencing the corporate world with my full potential, and I will give my best to get the best out of myself.

name: Ishita
tagline: Bad at words. Never at decisions.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: COVID had just ended, so sem started late October. First day, new place, far from home, new people. I was excited to see everything but super nervous. Slowly tried to get to know everyone. We gathered in the basement, discussed cricket and hobbies, bonded over them and  that was start of it all.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: All the memories are awesome, I can't really pick favourites. But definitely the treats, late night dance practices, playing games throughout the night, parties, staying up all night to watch the sunrise, walks around campus and ISB road. And definitely my birthdays. Got a home away from home.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: All the amazing people I met, seniors, juniors, my batchmates and advisor. Making random plans. All the club meets and events. I spent almost 4 years around people and I could meet them just by walking up to them. It hits that I don't even know when I will get to see them again next.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I've stopped caring so much about what everyone thinks. I used to seek validation and overthink everything. Learnt a lot from everyone around me, now I just go for it. It's better to do it than to have regrets. And in general, the biggest change is campus itself. For all the first year "befores," there's no same place left to take an "after." Everything changed : the buildings, the main gate, TNUB road, the messes. Everything.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I want to travel. Just pack a light bag and go for a trek, or a long drive. Watch the sun set over mountains, wake up to mist still sitting on the valleys, find that one stall in the middle of nowhere. Unpopular opinion — maggi tastes best during a trek. I want to paint all the beautiful scenes in my book. For the long run, maybe research. I just want to keep asking the questions nobody else is bothered to ask.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Late night assignments which we kept doing till 6AM. Moss cases with friends. Funny Interactions with seniors. Unprepared Project presentations. Cycling and swimming with friends during holidays. Enjoying Biryani and Apricot Delights . Humanizing AI in Assignments. Midnight Damsharas. Being single!!

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Working on assignments with friends, late-night talks, and birthday parties in the mess. Our faces when grades didn't match our effort. DLF nights and first-day shows at Sudarshan! Cracking jokes in our group of four and the constant fear of Moss. That’s student life!

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I learned to be independent and lead five-member teams seamlessly. I stayed connected with most people I met, gaining coding skills and life lessons from friends. While I grew more mature, I also faced increased pressure and emotional dependency. Through projects, I learned to engage freely with professors, gaining tech experience and adapting to the software life. I'm even becoming more "Gen Z" by the day!

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I plan to work in the corporate world until my family is financially stable, then transition into academia as a professor to lead a happy life. I need to master handling pressure, strive for emotional independence, and be content while still working hard. Life is like a non-convex happiness function; we shouldn't just act as gradient ascent to find a local maxima. We must keep searching for the global maxima by experiencing the minimas and learning from them! I will try to have same consistency!

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: My first day was quite hectic, i was suffering from viral when i landed in hyd, had to visit the doctor the same morning before coming to campus, getting late for the registration process. After that i spent the rest of the day roaming and exploring campus, bunking all the orientation meets.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: I will miss the working at night culture across the campus. I love how every meet starts post 9, how you can see more people roaming around at 12 am than 12 pm, even the canteen serves till 4am. Will miss spending time with friends,  walking on campus roads and my messed up sleep cycle.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: For me, the biggest change has to be the way I see IIITH with, from a place where I came to learn, get some skills, build a carrer; from a place far away from my home to a place that is my home now. IIITH is a place where I have my most cherished memories, a place I won't be able to forget for a life time. The friends I made here are like family now and my time here is what has shaped me to who I am today.

One of the first friends I made in CLD, and also my go-to person to rant about CLD academics and lab struggles. Mows, I have always enjoyed my time spent with you, being it music sessions or convocation. I hope we plan a session again in future. You have a good sense of humour and a great singing voice. You are dedicated and disciplined. I hope you deserve the best. All the best mows..
testimonials.from: Vellanki Venkata Sundara Raghava Chetan Krishna

testimonials.text: Mowss !! One of the first friends on the campus. First two yearss lo we enjoyed a lot raa from random night egg fried to DSA assignments. CLD kassi chala dedicated raa nuvvu, edaina anukunte adi chesethav without fail. Maaku kooda konchem ivvara nee dedication. Ee 1 year ? college lone untav kada kaluddamm. All the best raa....

manam brain rot movies chustu daggara ayyam ra. flop movies ni analyse and jokes vestu chusevallam. tarvata manam chaalaane convos chesam. idi + studies ela manage chestavo maku kuda cheppara 😄. neeku antu oka set of principles untai and you follow them, i like the way u stand by your principles. 
haa inka apukolenu ra neeku nacchaka poina you are CLD kassi🌝(backed by statistics)

next year kuda undi kada, we can meet often and enjoy. All the best and Take care

Mowaa! You’re the first person in college I ever called that. Starting lo intha buddiga vunnaadu anukunna, tharvata telisindi neelo unna chilipithanam 😏. Down to earth undadaniki try chestaav, but in the process baaga athi chestaav 🤣. One quality of you I look up to is that em chesina full clarity tho chestaav, mundu nunde plan chestaav, optimal ga chestaav. You plan and keep your life balanced, both acads and having fun. Research lo already thop, wishing you the best in other things as well!
One of the Sweetest persons all around campus. Always brightens to see and greet him whenever we cross paths. Also an amazing TA! Wishing you the best brother!

Vivek mowaa.. very dedicated and smart person.. can always reach you for any technical support and will always be ready to help.. nv workspace lo undadam valla.. ekkuva time spend cheyalaekapoyaam.. but few interactions aina.. had very great memories.. especially during the last batch trip.. always cares for people around you.. face meedha eppudu constant smile maintain chesthaav.. dont loose that.. keep smiling and ATB for your future.
Vivek! Such a kind, smart person - loved talking with you. TAship with you was a great experience, definitely a highlight of IIIT for me. Wishing the best for you always. Hope we meet soon!

Vivek mows 😭 you’re one of the biggest kassi’s I know, same padathi & same kassi since day one 😂 You work hard for your future and always stay focused while making good memories too. From sharing naughty childhood stories to watching bad movies just to roast them 😈😁, I enjoyed all those moments. Marks & CG nuv techukuni malli “helana cheyakura” antav entra 😭 You’ve got huge potential, yet stay humble, simple & loyal. Keep smiling & all the best ✨\n

Asking you to be my ISS Project partner has definitely been the best decision I have ever made. I am glad, happy, and proud about how our relationship has transformed over the years. I could not have asked for a better companion than you. We have been together for every single part of college life, and I absolutely do not regret any bit of it. You have seen my lows, cried along with me in them, and equally cherished my wins. Cannot wait to see you achieve your goals!

The sweetest person and a true perfectionist...you inspire me in new ways every time. Honestly, you’re the ideal roommate anyone could ask for. I only wish we had made even more memories together. No matter where life takes you, I’ll always be rooting for you. Here’s to all the amazing chapters ahead, roomie 🤍\n

Hello Ketaki, you’re like a ray of sunshine, and your smile is so bright ki it automatically makes me smile too. You’re always so principled and diligent, I wish I had even 5% of your discipline. You give your best to everything you do, and it really shows. Tum itna accha classical kar leti ho, your expressions are genuinely beautiful, dekhke bahut maja aata hai. All the best for your future endeavours!!!

I genuinely love talking to you - from every random thing to life in general. Conversations with you always feel so effortless, engaging, and comforting. \nYou’re such a cheerful, sweet, and kind person, always ready to help the people around you without a second thought. And beyond that, you’re so incredibly talented,  I’ve always been in awe of your dance and the grace with which you manage everything.\nPS : LTRC mai raat ke 5 bje tak baatein karna meri core memory hai!

One of the very few people as short as me🤣, talking to you has always taught me something new. I really respect how true you are to your principles and hobbies. You are a very graceful and talented dancer and I really appreciate how you pursued your hobby inspite of acads. You are so sincere, kind, hard working and forgiving. All the best for your future, looking forward to a lot more fun together in 5th year💜💜.

Probably the sweetest and politest person ever. The person I look upto, almost never a rule breaker. Always so disciplined, organised, just absolutely love it. Somehow never gets dizzy while spinning so much I genuinely can’t forget that navrang performance and at the end of it even gave expressions. Stay the same.

Hello Ketaki, humne shayad itna time saath mein spent nhi kiya, but jab bhi kiya it was full of fun and laughter. You’re an amazing dancer and a great fitness enthusiast! I still don’t understand how you run such long marathons, I’d probably die 😭. Stay beautiful, stay happy, aur milte rehna aise hi :)

Ketakii, the way you manage everything, from studies to workouts, with so much discipline is honestly amazing. Matlab without fail tu workout karti hai and keeps yourself so fit, sach mein kuch seekhna chahiye mujhe hehe. Mast hai yaar tu, just be the way you are 🤍\n

You're super sweet and also super smart! Love how you're so easy to talk to, plus 100% respect for how you balance everything, research, acads, social life, dance, fitness, total allrounder bhai. Vayu races mein toh you are the only ray of hope lol how do you run so fast its crazy. All the best for the future and knowing you, you’ll fs get everything you want!

Ketaki, you are genuinely one of the sweetest and most soft-spoken people ever. Always smiling and spreading such calm vibes around you. And your Kathak is soo soo beautiful and graceful, honestly mesmerizing to watch. Even though we didn’t talk a lot, we still share so many lovely core memories. Hope we stay in touch. Milte rehna cutie :)

My vayu classical dance partner :), it was really fun practicing and rehearsing kathak with you during our freshers and cult night. One of the sweetest and humble person I know. All the very best for your future.

Hey Ketaki! You've always been like my big sister. Lucky to have  you and Maitreya! You guys always used to listen to my rants and  have always guided me.. Your dedication and hardwork inspires me every single time!! Such a strong woman and a great dancer you are.. I wish you all the best and hope you pursue your interests in the future too!! Thank you for everything!!

Short and sweet. She's always smiling, even at bad jokes lmao... like this one:) But genuinely haven't seen you angry, I hope I don't as well. It was fun playing basketball during that one summer, that summer was the best one in college for me.

Hey Ketaki, You always greet and talk to others with so much warmth that it always feels reassuring. I really love your dance! It was lovely getting to know you. Keep the same vibe you always have and I Wish you great success ahead !\n
The only girl who runs on a regular basis. Random conversations with you in the mess or randomly on the street is great. All the best.

Hi, you are really a sweet person Ketaki. Best JPMC partner. Can't believe kabhi koi course project toh saath na kiya seedha bahar ki assignments kr rhe saath mei lol. It was fun! Stay the same buddy! Wishing you the best!

Hi!! I've known you first as Nida's roomie, enjoyed talking with you then, really love love your dance, you give a very friendly vibe whenever we talk, its easy to approach you, thanks for creating that space!!\n\nWishing you luck for everything ahead:)

Youve always got the sweetest smile ever whenever we talk. so kind too! I remember one cultnight i saw you dance and was SO in AWE of it. like you are incredible. i find it cool that you run, youre smart asf, you dance, and youre ingeneral a joy to be around. stay cool!

Yoo! kab deploy karna hai MedVQA?? the faulty RAG with great output results ;D..i admire your work ethic and dedication towards the work that you do..we have only worked on a single project together but it's easy to extrapolate :)..work with the same intent and dedication and all the best!!
Hi Ketaki!\nIt's been a great knowing you these past few years! You're very kind-hearted and a very graceful artist. I admire your dedication a lot. \nAll the best for your future!
loved your presence in the campus life! very sweet yet smart person, liked the mess sessions and old city trip together! i hope we stay in touch and also do teach me how to prep for marathons :p

Dadiji of B20 and one of the most genuine people on campus, with no fake identity. Amazing dancer and a great person with no enemies, especially in an environment where everyone fakes themselves. All the best for the future!

Always liked working with you as a team partner. You’ve always been super disciplined, and genuinely fun to be around, which made all the projects much easier. Hope life ahead treats you really well :)

Fellow Punekar and one of the most authentic, nice and talented people on campus... be it dancing, running or anything in between. You've always been so sweet to talk to. Always rooting for you and all the best!

Was fun taking sanskrit Classes with you....From heated conversations on what to teach and clueless faces upon getting a question asked in class...It was a real fun that I will remember always...\n\nGood luck for your future...

Hands down best CC undersec and mentor for juniors from our batch!! One of the smartest and most trustworthy people I've met in our batch, you're gonna achieve so many great things in life ✨ Missed you during our secretary tenure a lot... Big fan of your kathak performances 🙏 Do stay in touch and all the best for your future :)

Ketaki, you genuinely feel like the definition of an ideal student: hardworking, kind and always ready to help others. I’d honestly love to go for a run together someday… if I can somehow keep up with your pace 😭 I’m really glad I got to know you. Stay exactly the way you are, and wishing you all the success and happiness in the world 🤍 Keep in touch <3

Chetki! Such a hardworking person, great at acads, research, dance … all you do is just bang on. I have always enjoyed talking to you, you make it so friendly. Organising tdc events with you was always fun. I looked forward to B20 outings and random meet ups in KCIS, be it to rant about courses or discuss something important. And ofc Megathons, always enjoyed working together, you just made it perfect! I will miss them a lot. Be in touch! All the best!

Hi Ketaki! It was so nice knowing you....you are a very sweet and kind person. Maine tumhe kaafi tang bhi kiya hai uske liye sorry XD. OG B20 dinners with you and others will always be memorable. CC dinners me tumhari presence miss karte hai hum sab :) Keep in touch...wishing you all the very best for your future. Stay happy always :)

Khet-ki Organic Shetye!!! From Vayu in first sem and seeing you do kathak (U ARE THE BESTTT) so gracefully won my heart! Hola Senorita !! One of the most kindest and innocent person. I loved doing PM101 project with you, and had a lot of fun in all our conversations. You are also really smart and I wish you best of luck for everything you do in future.

Dear Ketaki, thank you for being such a nice friend to me. I'll never forget the OGB20 outings and the interactions i had with you. You were always very soft spoken, kind and helpful to me. I find you very hard working and intelligent too. I'm fascinated by how well you have done in college and research. I want to learn more form you. hello ketaki! you are one of the most calm and polite people i know. it has always been great having you around. i've really enjoyed all our random chats, whether it was about courses, the research grind, or just our fun outings together. all the best for everything ahead and let's stay in touch!
Meri Kathak partner, haven't met a more talented and graceful dancer yaar, looking forward for rocking the stage with our Kathak dance vahini <3\nBest of luck <3

Hey Ketaki! You’re one of the sweetest people I know in the batch (so kind that you hardly swear 😂). I am constantly impressed by how skilled you are in so many different things, be it dancing or research. All the best for all future endeavours!

One of the icons of our CLD batch. Humble, silent, and good at everything. Found out very late that you're one of the best distance runners in our college. Very cool, all the best for your future Ketaki!

Admire your dedication and passion towards the things you love (honestly inspiring). Super fun to be around, an crazzyy all-rounder. Watching you perform classical dance was just one of the most beautiful moments. Very few people manage to be talented and effortlessly cool at the same time <3.

I still remember meeting you for the first time during pune people meeting. Since then our friendship has grown into so much more. You are a very kind and soft spoken person. I've always loved your company, be it projects or CLD classes. Good luck for the future and hopefully time pe graduate ho gaye!

name: Kevin Rakesh Thakkar
tagline: Jack of all trades, master of some.....

testimonials.text: Mera bhai, bestie, aur apna Surati Lala (#nani-naroli)! Har activity mein mera partner. Har situation mein itna calm rehna koi tujhse sikhe. Mera ultimate travel partner—Activa pe random places explore karna aur late-night ghumna sabse best part tha. Intern ke time ka tension aur sath mein kiye gaye maze hamesha yaad rahenge. Tu hamesha help karne ke liye ready rehta hai. Aage bhi hum hamesha ek dusre ke pillar bane rahenge. All the best for the new journey, bhai!

500 characters genuinely can’t even tell a glimpse of what we had between us ❤️. Truly a brother from another mother. Honestly, I don’t even know what college life would’ve looked like without you. \nCollege may have ended, but it gave me a brother for life... someone who stood beside me through every high and low, happiest and darkest moment. And no matter where life takes us, I really hope this bond never changes 🤝❤️.

Surti Lala! You are the most Jolly character I have met! Extremely talented and an Amazing friend! I remember from the first time we went to dinner as group to today, you add a flavour to the group. The one guy who really embodies TMKOC ☺️. These years would definitely not have been this good without you and your OVER ANALYSIS! Every stage in my life, I will remember the "Process of Doing It At End" theory 😂.\n\nPS: Kim ni Note, Surat karta Lambi Chale Che!

The optimiser from Surat, no words can describe you... the way our friendship has grown over the 4 years can't explain. Lucky to have a friend like you whom i can count on forever. The farewell gift you gave me is so precious would always remember that. So many cafes, restaurants, photos, memories we have together. Last sem would have been so boring without your room and you. Still wish you coming to BLR>>> Hope we stay the same, keep connected! Loveuuu

Kevin, it was in the second year that we became good friends. From late-night walks to study and gossip sessions,every moment with you has been unforgettable.Teasing you has always been one of my favourite hobbies—I don’t think that’ll ever change!😜Thank you for being there during my tough phases, especially in 6th and 7th sem. Bas ek hi request hai—mujhe bhul mat jaanaaa and stay in touch.Hoping our friendship lasts foreverrrr :). \nP.S.-Vo sourdough pizza dominos ka bilkul acha nhiiii thaaa 😭

Every time we meet, it turns into the most hilarious and laugh-filled situation 😭😂. You’re a true all-rounder — funny, mature, dedicated, and super easygoing. Our TMKOC telepathy is unmatched XD. I’ll always cherish our late-night hangouts, gossips, games, reels, and dance practices together. Your hard work during exams is genuinely inspiring. People like you make campus life more lively and beyond just academics. All the very best for the future, and will definitely stay in touch!

Surti lala!!! Jyare bhi story mukvi hoi, photos leva hoi, new reel shoot, there is only one person everyone remembers!! Group ka jolly boy! The one with the best trip plans, pachi bhale e trips thai ke na thai! Kaam kare ke nai, eni gaurantee nai, but kuch bhi ho, kaam last moment pe kar hi deta hai!! The go to biryani partner, of c with tmkoc!! Fellow CSK and thala fan! 500 char is not enough to describe our friendship! Still remember the fun times we had in rajkot Now my turn to come to surat!

Crazyy yaari hai tere sath bhai ab idhar itni space nhi sab likh payu but yeah making memories with you is the most valuable thing for me. Hum jitna ghuma hai bakchodi ki hai all those late night talks walks ghumna were og. Also thanks for being supportive and trusty. We really spent a hell lot good time together in our clg life and hoping tu BLR aye and or bhi maje kre and trip too. All the very best bro for your future ahead and yeah thanks for adding vibrant colours to my life. Love you bro❣️

Bro the number of times I beat you in FIFA with Germany should be illegal at this point — and somehow you'd still queue up for round 2. One of the most helpful guys I know fr, never once said no when I needed something. And those train rides back home together were genuinely some of the chillest hours of college. Lucky to have you brother. Stay in touch — and pick a better team next time.

Kevin sir, humne saath main bahut acha time spend kiya, from meeting first day as gujjus to leaving at last day as best friends, the journey was mesmerizing!
you are such a genuine soul, joyous, cheerful, extremely smart and dedicated towards your work, inspirational!
Love the way we had friendly fights all the time, adds a diff flavour to our friendship.
Apki joking skills and timings humesha yaad rahegi mujhe and apka ka gift, really close to my heart <3
Blr main milte rahena, keep smiling!

Relationships, academics, social life, extracurriculars, poems — bhai tu har jagah kaise accha hai.Ek aadmi mein itna talent aane mein usually janam lag jaate hain.Teri kavitaon ka toh kya hi kehna, aur dance mein front row ke liye to tu koi dharne pr bhi beth skta h… respect.Tere se genuinely bahut kuch seekhne ko mila — especially life ko itne positive way mein kaise jeete hain, khush kaise rehte hain, aur itni saari cheeze balance kaise karte hain.Stay the same bhai, and atb for future  ✨.

We have shared so many first-year memories together. Chatting for hours in the open-gym & bonding over our shared love of poetry is something I will always remember.\nYou were also one of the very first friends I made in college, truly cherish the bond we have :)

Amazing garba company always! Had really fun times during Navratri, random Felicity events, and our after-class VC breaks. You’re genuinely so funny and such an amazing person to hangout with. Stay safe aur pls kuch mat tudvana lol ! Hope to see you around! <3

Kevin, you are the most chill person in our circle. You’re the Creative Director of the group. whether it’s choreographing a reel or finding the most aesthetic spots for photos, you’re the real MVP. And of course, the group’s official Yapper. It’s been a great working with you on various projects too. Keep that vibe alive and all the best for your future!

One of the few gujjus I actually talked to 😭 our dance practices were always great and yes mujhe bhi teri saari gossips indirectly mil hi jaati thi :) Thanks for teaching garba during Navratris, that was genuinely fun. Always stay the way you are and all the very best for everything ahead!!

hey kevin, remembered you dancing to DJ tillu, absolutely hilarious. you're funny, so easy to talk to, and it's been fun knowing you for the last few years. data systems ka trauma saath mein seh liya tha. fir se chalte hai chocolate room xD

Your mindset of always wanting to try something new is my favourite. Jugaad kese karna hai wo aap se zyada kisi ko nhi aata. I feel you have played every sport made. Poem mujhe likhni acchi nhi aati, but you made hanging out so much more fun.  Will miss you a lot!\n
Kevin, it was great to know you. I’m genuinely excited that we’ll be working in the same company as colleagues (hopefully they don't kick us out 🤞).

I feel lucky ki first year mein mere baaju mein tu baithta tha. \nSaath mein class mein itna timepass and maza kiya hai and saath mein ResearchFest tshirt bhi "borrow" ki thi xD\nKeep dancing and laughing and all the best for everything bhai.

Thakkar bhai one of my favourite dancers in batch, loved being in TDC with you and dancing with you in almost all the events! Clash of Duos UG2 mein try karne mein kaafi mazze aaye the lmao. Kaafi kassi bhi ho aap, which I can relate to a lot 🙏 Never lose that enthusiasm of yours, aur kabhi dobara milke naachenge ✨ All the best for your future!

Hi kevin! You are always-ready-to-help soul. And it has been so fun to have random conversations with you. I have said it earlier to many, but saying it to you as well that the gujju gang is one of the best gangs I have seen on campus - the one gang I felt the safest and happiest with:) I hope we stay in touch! All the best!

Hello Kevin, we met during the induction trip, your company was soo fun. You are such a fun person to walk to. Thank you for the sweetest birthday wish ever (genuinely bhai bohot hi creative tha). You are an amazing dancer (I still remember your drums wala step flashmob mei 🤣). Tujhse garba seekhne mei bhi bohot maza aata hai. You are so true to your roots and honestly very kind, respectful, smart and hard-working. Wish you achieve all your dreams, all the best!!

Kevin bhai!! One more gujju jena garba upar loko fidaa thay! great friend, great dancer and badhi j activities ma part lenaro ek matra gujju..you've truly enjoyed the college life :) Aapde ghani random vaato upar hasya chhe and saathe loko ni majaak udavi chhe XD..aavo j attitude rakhje bro, helpful, humble, ready to try new things, welcoming and always smiling! stay the same brother, wishing you all the very best!!\nPS: "Shu paachhu aapdu mann mohi jashe?" ;)

Kevin!! Vayu Faad hai Vayuwaale Faad hai! Thank you for making all those practice sessions so so so worth and fun! Your passion for dance whether garba or on cultnight is amazing! never stop dancing and being so fun! Really glad could meet you on campus! Stay connected!!
Super cheerful and friendly! Its always easy and fun to talk to you. Had a lot of fun doing vayu dances together in first and last years. Good luck for everything ahead!!

Kevin, you’re genuinely such a kind and genuine person. Even though we didn’t get to talk a lot, I really appreciate you always reaching out and making the effort. It truly meant a lot to me. Stay happy always, keep smiling and please keep in touch <3
The always smiling and jugaadu guy on campus.....\n\nGood luck for your future and may u succeed alot in your life...

Upcoming LinkedIn influencer 💼🔥. One of the best ISS TAs, juniors ko jyada marks diya tha, so obviously baccho ka favourite TA 🤝😂. cool guy, lab me 1st year vallo ko bhi bahut help kiya hai, doubt ho toh seedha tumhare paas hi aate hain 😎. Good luck bro, hope you achieve whatever you wish for 🚀✌️.

Hii kevin bhai! You are truly amazing, the most jolly and loving Gujju I know! Organizing those CLC events together was such a blast. From mentoring the juniors and handling those frantic last-minute arrangements to planning the events and the whole interview process, every bit of it was so much fun.

I have countless memories just from living on the same wing together! We definitely need to catch up in Bangalore.
Wishing you the very best in all your future endeavors

My brother Tharker, one of the true all-rounders of the batch, good at everything he does, be it sport, dance, academics, everything. Also a very sweet person, makes sure that the whole group is always having fun. Loves to plan incredible adventures and trips, which make up such insane memories. Also love how despite being so money-minded, he makes sure that "Doston se nhi kamata hoon". Always looks so reckless yet things always makes things work out! Its been a joy with you always brother!

The best cool guy I was so happy you came to 5th floor in the final year , you are so joyous and updated with all news and incidences in colleges , studying with you in BRSM was fun and so was having you as a TA for MMIB. Cheers bro 🥂

You made my college life even more funnn , especially the 2nd year (CIneDanceCon was the besttt) , It was soo fun pulling all-nighters and playing random games or talking about anything . You are really sweet and understanding plus a very good friendd.\nI wish you the very best for your future, Kevin and let's stay in touch :)

Won't forget those vayu nights, 1st person I met on college and thought if he is a foreigner, very sweet guy by nature and bound to happen ( due to the gujjuness), Idk if you know how much I love garba but surely one day I will come to Gujarat for celebrating it with you, shuru me humara trio tha ( Sparsh) but dont know how it got broken slowly, anyway I hope we will stay in touch and connect whenever possible.

it's been a long journey together.......jo bhulaye na bhulne vali......have known u since the very first sem, we've been on a lot of outings together, can never forget those bangalore weekends.......take care of yourself and keep shining!
Really Cool Guy....will remember all our trips to wonderala,ramoji..always had fun with u ...always keep smiling...wish u achieve whatever u dreamt of in lifeee

Kevin bro, bohat miss karunga bhai woh badminton, fifa, cricket, patte and especially  pickleball. Jab bhi pickleball khelne jaana ho humesha sabse phele Tereko call Kiya. Kevin bhaiii ! Amazing personality, vibrant, optimistic, focused, and always upbeat ! Felt so good and easy to be around you. Wish you the best for everything ahead ! Have an amazing career and a fantastic life !

Thanks for being my support system n my partner in bad decisions n impulsive plans (also helping me survive them). I hope u get us a farm someday (we can be happy tree friends).

Thank you for being autistic and making college feel like home! journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Reached campus early, unsure of what to expect. Met a few seniors, made a few friends, and even got lost on the way from South Mess to Vindhya, especially after the campus tour. Somewhere in that chaos, my closest friend group formed, still going strong. The earliest I’ve ever slept in IIIT life 😅.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: My first birthday on campus and the party after. Random campus walks. Endless all-nighters during exams. The craziest was handling InfoComm and AEC deadlines, a viva and a presentation the next day, then a DSA lab exam, all on NO sleep. But those random bike rides at 3 AM to Charminar remain best.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Most of all, my friends, especially after I got converted, having to stay without them here for an extra year is going to be the hardest part, no more 3 AM bike rides, no more campus walks, no more gossip 🥹🥲. But the Wednesday Lab meetings are unforgettable too - especially skipping them (IYKYK).

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer:
From a fixed sleep schedule to complete unpredictability, from starting assignments early to late submissions, that’s been the shift I felt.

Along the way, being part of NSS, Felicity, and CLC taught me lessons beyond academics while working in teams for the community, positives, negatives, and criticism.

Joining CVEST completely changed my perception towards academics and research. From being organised to going with the flow, college life has prepared me to face whatever the future brings.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Maybe a PhD, maybe a job — still figuring out what the world has in store for me. Just trying to stay grounded, take the unconventional path when it feels right, and trust the journey as it unfolds. Want to live life to the fullest, and somewhere along the way, finally tick off that world tour too!!!

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: First day on campus feels like a blur now, but I still remember being extremely scared. Everything was so new, new people, new place, new life altogether. I met some really cool people on the 3rd floor that day, little did I know they would go on to become such an important part of my college life.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: One of my best campus memories has to be all the random late-night walks and those long conversations that went on for hours. Recently, we went on a scooty ride & drove for almost the whole night. It was chaotic, spontaneous, and honestly one of the most fun experiences I’ve had here :)

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: This has to be the people I met here. What started as a completely unfamiliar place slowly became a safe space and a second home because of them. I think that’s what I’ll carry with me the most after college, not just the memories, but the people who made those memories so special.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Looking back, I feel I have grown a lot as a person. I came to college as someone who was unsure of herself, and honestly quite uncertain about the world around her. I have learnt to embrace uncertainty & became better at prioritizing what truly matters. College challenged me in so many ways, but it also helped me evolve into a much more confident and self-aware version of myself.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I’ll just let life unfold in its own beautiful ways.\nI’m looking forward to new experiences, meeting new people, exploring more places, and constantly learning more. There’s a lot ahead, and I’m excited to see where life takes me next.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: The first day on campus was very overwhelming. Coming to the campus I never imagined getting into, meeting loads of people some of whom I have the privilege of calling friend. Starting this new chapter of my life, I was nervous, afraid, anxious and happy at the same time.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Don't have any one specific memory but I cherish all those time I spent with my friends. All the gaming nights, all nighters for exams, "discussion sessions", random jamming sessions, movie nights, biryani times, Dj nights etc.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Friends. And the OG kadamb biryani.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Tried to become more open to people. Learnt a lot about myself and just life in general. Got better immunity (thanks to the water and food here).

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I hope I knew.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Scary. New people, new city and a completely unfamiliar environment. Desire to attend all events, consume all the knowledge and to utilise every opportunity to prove myself. Wanted to do everything while at the same time was too scared to do anything. It was all uncertain.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Might be recency bias, but the meals during batch trip. Every single known person from campus, sitting in their respective groups & me popping in n out of each group chatting with everyone. I thought I want these people around me forever, it felt like peak comfort, it felt like I was right at home.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: People. The spontaneity & randomness of every plan -going to a room & finding 15 people doing the randomest shit, 3 am David's visits, the 4 am walks, JC visits, the chaotic all nighters, the plans no one planned, the philosophical convos. The bond with everyone was priceless. Will miss it a lot!!

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Completely transformed as a person, slight improvements in haircut, fashion sense & ability to make decisions. Became a slightly better person too (and hopefully a better friend to most). The standout biggest change though is my outlook towards life & the goal is to maximize fun. Less bedrotting, more human interactions, more impromptu plans, more masti and for once stressing out less about deadlines & more about what is the next fun thing to do. Learned how to love life!

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Still a lot of uncertainty, got a lucky draw for a foreign offer, and life took an unexpected turn, "Do it for the Plot" people said and I obliged. Let's see how Denmark treats me. The plan is to be a corporate slave for 2 years just to figure out if I can live the 9 to 5 "dream", then I'll decide if I wanna lead my life differently, maybe pivot to academia (try to become a mathematician coz why not) (also I'm lame & I find it cool) or do something completely unexpected. Only time will tell.
