journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I drove in with my parents. I remember seeing a few seniors who were walking past us laughing together. I silently wished to have that someday and I think I have. I remember playing tennis and meeting a few people who've been friends to this date. It was a lot to process but that change felt good.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: There are so many, very tough to point out to just one thing. KC definitely, this particular cabin (Forever grateful), handling Hospitality for 2 years of felicity, random hangouts in 516, laughing with friends in the mess, pulling up to HSK on farewell in suits etc. Yep, cannot pin point to one.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Walking around the campus listening to music/with friends while sipping on Dammam's chai/coffee. Very refreshing.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I was a little (debatable maybe) short-tempered when i first came to college and realised it by my second year that I had to change that. I think ive done a decent job at it and im far away from that now. Im also much more self aware about my surroundings and myself in general. I know elements of life which are important to me that I want to pursue for now and im grateful for that.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Next comes adulting, no? Real, proper adulting. No shell to hide under anymore haha. Now begins the actual 20's where you discover yourself better, you pick something and work towards it, where actions matter more than ideation does. I want to travel, a lot, not necessarily outside India but backpack within India itself, climb mountains and shit. I also dont want to move forward aimlessly, i think panning out your goals on a yearly basis helps, leading upto what you want someday in the future.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: the campus felt massive. after settling into bakul and meeting my roommate, i headed to the orientation at Himalaya w/ help from apex volunteers. got lost on the way back and wandered around iiit for an hour before finally finding my way. later saw the signboards and realised that i was (am) stupid.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: random late-nights in bakul where i played card, board and video games with the gang, and had deep discussions about life, academics, politics and everything in between.\n\nalso the late night walks around campus, especially when it was raining outside were very fun.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: the close proximity to friends and other like-minded people that i have here. i don't think i will be able to find something like that ever again.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer:
3 things actually. firstly, i used to get annoyed by even the faintest of sounds when i was busy working on something (back in UG-1), even yelled at people on occasion. now i'm the one annoying people.

secondly, i was a very picky eater before i joined college. i'm still picky but only when it comes to vegetarian food :P (will eat anything that moves).

lastly, i used to stay in my room all the time back then. i've come to a realisation that i won't spontaneously combust if i touch grass.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: chilling in the short term, catalysing a nuclear war in the long term.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: My first day on campus with my parents felt nothing but joyful. Looking up to apex mentors like gods, making new friends, getting know each other JEE ranks. I still remember the moment of having lunch in yuktahar with my family, telling goodbye to them and getting to know each other until midnight.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: One of the memory was celebrating my birthday with a huge crowd and cutting 3 birthday cakes, getting too many gifts from some of my closest people, having a late night truth or dare session under the stars, dancing around, applying cake to face, washing it off.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: I will miss having some of the best people around me, people whom i admire and people who admire me. All the juniors who were the best siblings that i can ask for. Mainly the late night movies, bike rides, unplanned trips, never ending gossip.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I used to be this innocent girl who did not understand sarcasm, people ditching me from back, people disliking me for who i was, very stubborn to change. But now i am this matured young woman, who knows how to deal with life even in it its most complicated form.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I am joining Linkedin, Bangalore. Probably getting married at age of 23 or 24 and continuing with my job, travelling with my partner, learning new hobbies and elevating my current hobbies.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I was really nervous on my first day because I wasn’t sure whether I would fit in or make friends. But thanks to Freshers and the first few weeks on campus, I made friends much quicker than I expected. Before I knew it, my fear was replaced by excitement, confidence and some of the best memories🫶🏽

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Really can't choose. There have been so many memories that are close to my heart and I will cherish forever like - late night walks with Shravan, waiting at bakul bench after being super drunk, running around the campus for treasure hunt and so much more!

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Late night chai walks for deep discussions (aka gossips XD) with Shravan♥️

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: The biggest change in me since first year is how much more confident I’ve become. I used to worry a lot about fitting in but now I’m comfortable being myself and know that I’ll naturally connect with the right people.\n\nThe best lesson college taught me is to keep having fun and enjoying life, no matter how hectic or stressful things get.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I’ll be joining Microsoft in Hyderabad as a Software Engineer and, of course, continuing to have fun and enjoy life along the way.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Well I didn't know anyone prior to coming through any telegram groups or anything. I was very nervous too. I started meeting and making some new friends on orientation , cluster meet , Vayu meets for freshers , etc. And yea as soon as I started making friends I started feeling like myself.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Damn its tough to name one. Games we play in hostel , those late night chats , Jamming Sessions ( BackLog Boys ) , winning battle of bands : ) , late night turf cricket and football , campus walks , some secret sharing sessions .

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: My Friends. Everything I did with them will always stay in my memory. I think I have done a fairly good job in capturing all the memories in videos and photos, and will cherish them forever thinking about these good days.. These were my 4 best years of life. Hopefully reunions keep happening.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Probably being so open with anyone which I was not before. JEE made me too introverted, atleast Now I have a lot of these friends with whom I dont ever have to filter myself. Just be myself , rant about stuff , insult each other ( some do take offence but lite idc : )

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Well next meetup is on convocation and then hopefully our plans to keep meeting each other regularly do happen. I will always be up for any plans. I know everyone will change , their priorities will change , but once we do manage to meet , I know we all will be back to our college personalities of being pure BAKCHOD.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Walked to many people, asked their names, spoke a few words and forgot about them in few days 😅. Meet Chaganti, became one of my close friends, because his room was beside mine in first year✌️. Meet two of my old friends. Night attended the cluster meet and went into all buildings alone at night.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: How jealous i was on couples who were on road while i was on solo campus walks 🫠. My laziness to study for all exams (all were one night batting). The way, i shout while watching anime (especially rom-coms) after 12 am, many nights in my room😫. Most of all, People I cared.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: My mentality in all kind of things, there were both good and bad changes in my way of understanding people. Some liked it, few didn't and others, i can't tell 🙄. Gainied how to survive in many bad situations. In the end, learned reasons for how i changed myself because of my own choices, maintaining (and correcting a few) them in life is remaining.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Have some crazy ideas - should learn how to bring them to life and achieve them. Have to empty my shopping cart by the next 5 years 🤪 (Should atleast try). Should learn how to cook in different styles so i can finally prepare the dishes i  watch in insta at 2 am almost every night. Then, Go on a solo trip to japan after my MS. By that time, should find a life partner😉 (Hopefully). Last but not least, should do some adventurous activities without telling family 😁.

journal.answer: It was a cloudy day. Prolly rained a lil too. Saw a dog on top of the bridge at research street, probably lilly. After all the shifting and formalities, started an entry in my diary. Couldn't finish it tho, as I had to rush somewhere for something else. aptly foreshadowing most of my iiit life.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: This one time I was casually throwing with Kshitij Gajjar on a sunny evening. We were throwing at the football ground and it started raining. We continued throwing throughout the rain that evening. We didn't stop until     PEC switched off the lights. I was very happy that day.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Peanut butter banana at VC. Thanks to Aryaman for recommending that to me. Has truly been a lifesaver for it has been the replacement for all the meals I'd missed in the last 2 years.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: My frisbee skills maybe? \nAnyways, I think it's probably how I work. Not quite there yet, however it changed quite a lot.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Finish MS thesis and graduate. I'm a simple man.  I wanna be happy. The way to happiness for me is to do more quantum, play more frisbee and learn more math. Hopefully a short stint in the quantum industry before going for a PhD would be the ideal plan, however just like how you never know what the wave function collapses to when the time comes, life might take me on a completely different path.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Nervous, not sure of whats going to happen next, overwhelmed by everything that was going on, still managing to stay strong and exploring new things, making new friends and eventually making this random college my home.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: 3 of us getting locked inside a room during kalakshetra, seniors banging at our doors like idiots, using table to climb up to the slight openings we had in bakul rooms and using torch to find us, all of us trying to hide under beds and then getting locked inside :)

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Navratri nights, the 3-4 garba intro sessions which were meant to teach people garba, but eventually forgetting about  them and enjoying random garba steps they can't even process\nand then the final garba days, the energy we had, the company we had will always be missed

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: A lot has changed, learning to manage shit amount of workload and still managing to play pubg at night, learning to ignore imp things and focusing on the non imp ones, being consistent in the gym and inconsistent in classes, a lot has changed

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Corporate mazdoori and hopefully staying connected to all the friends i have made and hopefully i get time to spend on my hobbies, gym, painting, singing....

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: I was very excited on day one, but nervous as well since it was my first time being this far away from my hometown. I still remember being so confused about the building names! That’s the day I met the people who are my friends now.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Nothing particular, but definitely all the trips with my friends. Especially the Pondicherry trip

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: I will miss the chaos of last-minute assignment submissions and the late-night grinding before exam night. I will miss standing in the corridor or at the Bakul gallery, discussing random things with my friends.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: It would easily be my sleep schedule. In the beginning, I used to sleep by 11 PM, but by the end of college, I’m usually up until 4 AM! The other change is that I’ve been a bit more talkative now compared to how I was in my first year.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Corporate slavery

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: First day on campus was just me getting lost despite the campus being so small lol. There were way too many sessions happening and everything felt a little overwhelming at first. Somehow survived the chaos and figured things out eventually.\n

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: My best campus memories would be Felicity in 3rd year - the fest, late nights, dances ,fun events, and amazing vibes with friends. Another is from 1st year, spending hours in the workspace studying, doing projects, and struggling through assignments together. Those moments made campus life special.\n

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: One thing I’ll miss the most is the random late-night DLF trips, all-nighters before deadlines, night walks, and hanging out at JC. The smallest moments turned into the best memories because of the people around me.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Biggest change since 1st year has definitely been the people and experiences. I got to meet so many different people and ended up finding some really genuine connections along the way. I learnt a lot through research, internships, and team projects that pushed me out of my comfort zone. But beyond academics and work, I think the best part has been the memories I made and the timeless bonds I formed with people here.\n

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Honestly, I just want to keep learning a lot more in life - through work, new experiences, meeting different people, and everything that comes ahead. I’m really excited to start this new chapter in Bangalore, especially because so many of my friends will be there too. After spending years together in college, it feels nice knowing we’ll still get to be part of each other’s lives making a whole new set of memories together again.

testimonials.text: Jo, you’re my home. You became my comfort, my safe place, my happiness, and the one person who made this place truly feel like home. journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Very nervous, stepping into hostel life for the first time. Registrations were done, and we were given a bottle as a 25-year token and Ping freshers' issue. Had lunch at the South Mess with family, explored a few places and then slept, wondering what the next four years would hold.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: There are so many memories I can’t pick just one — from random chit-chats and midnight birthday celebrations with friends, to making it to the Dean’s List and finally getting placed.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Really miss those night walks with friends filled with gossip, staying up overnight working on projects, munching from David’s and JC, and impromptu plans to Creamstone and DLF.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Used to sleep early, but now it’s routine to stay up till 3 a.m., learning time management through packed deadlines and balancing academics with going-out plans.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: With AI changing so much around us, the future feels a bit uncertain and confusing, but I hope to figure out my path and be happy with what I do.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Being an extrovert, I saw the first day as one big party... fully excited for all the new people I was gonna meet. The absolute best moment was meeting Namrata for the first time, not knowing then that the encounter would become the most important part of my journey.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Cant say one but everytime I was surrounded by my true friends, those have been the absolute best times. Be it long walks, random talks or fun outings, these memories are gonna b engraved in my heart forever. Even some of the sad times are a good memory because of all the love my friends gave me<3

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: I’ll miss those midnight talks that shifted from random gossip to the deepest 3 hr conversations. I will also truly miss being on stage, whether for dancing, singing, achoring or acting. The practices, people and the final performance, all have been a very important part of my life.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I am no longer the naive little girl who had the expectations of an ideal world. Life at IIIT taught me how to navigate in the real world, deal with difficult personalities, handle criticism and most importantly the art of letting go. Another important thing was understanding the importance of a priority order in life and also realising how sometimes things can't be in control no matter how hard you try and there all you need is faith in destiny... everything eventually falls in place <3

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Looking ahead, I hope to be in a place where every day feels complete, fully embracing the purpose I believe I was meant to fulfill. I also want to make sure that I never lose the energy spark and have a positive approach to life irrespective of whatever hurdles come through. \n\nTruly looking forward to new experiences, new people and keeping the ones I hold close to me forever <3

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Nerve-wracking but exciting. The campus greenery was impressive, induction day energy all around, met new people.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Late-night walks and conversations. The chaos of organizing Fail? and Megathon. Winning our very first interbatch football tournament, interhouse cricket tournament. Taking a 5-wicket haul against the seniors. Can't pin it down to a single memory.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: The spontaneous plans at any point of the day - turfs, random hangouts, food runs, movies, Old City trips, renting scooters. And my friends, who made life at IIIT infinitely more bearable.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Way more open minded, outgoing, rational, less reactive (except if we're on the turf - still working on that). Changed a lot from the person who walked in four years ago, in ways that are hard to put into words. Overall for the better, I'd like to think.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Still figuring it out. Hoping for a life that's fulfilling, surrounded by good people. Wherever life goes, I intend on keeping the friends I made here close.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Excited and anxious. Wanted to explore the campus and make first interactions with people that will stay with me forever.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Hard to put a finger on it, but probably the first felicity and many other timepass sessions with friends in the final 2 years.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Passing time with smart and funny people. Talking about random stuff, playing random games and doing assignments/projects together.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Honestly, social and communication skills. Learnt how to deal with bad and good people, profs and friends, respectively. Learnt a lot from college, it helped improve my confidence and happiness level.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: If there's one thing I've learnt in college, it is to do things at the deadline. So I'm pretty unsure about what next, probably job for a few years? Not sure about higher studies, but no one knows what destiny holds in store!

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Honestly very blurry, I only remember talking to akshith and harsha and trying out oreo shake for the first time after so much hype. Honestly it doesn't even matter, might not remember my firsts but will def remember the fond memories with everyone.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Way too hard to pick one, so many moments in workspace first 2 years, playing basketball in 2nd year summer, and also the wonderful times in SPCRC and CVIT the last 2 years. Not just the fun times but also the grind together for exams and placements was something else.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Oh man, It feels impossible to move on from waking up and not seeing all the people I'm used to, who've been there all these 4 years.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Almost every year, I look back and think how dumb I am, proud of how much better I've got as a person in general.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: MLE at Meltwater to start with, and wherever life takes me after. Always flexible to the opportunities life throws at me

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: Came in formals as we were told for the photo, only to find hardly anyone did so. Met roomie and his parents, then we went out for stuff planned for us. Was so anxious I was avoiding eye contact with everyone lol. Was trying to small talk all who I met, but failed to recall their names right after.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: At the start of 2-2 summer I joined a friend for a rather good chaat in the mess snacks, and then a thunderstorm just came about. We decided to walk a few rounds in the downpour and got nicely drenched. I played Led Zeppelin out loud, we had a good convo and we took some nice pictures of the scenes.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: The friends I made along the way, that's what it's about anyways. Some of them will be in different cities, some on different continents. Hanging out, blowing money on food outside, ranting about life while chilling at Dammam, I will miss all that.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I have long hair now. Also more adipose tissue. And fewer brain cells.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: For now, I will work in the capitalist machine. At some point I'd like to go for further studies, but no clue yet.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Playing basketball (I will miss the team so much), hanging out with friends, and random late-night campus walks.

journal.answer: I think I’ve become much more open to experiences and people. I started pushing myself out of my comfort zone, being more active, and making memories instead of overthinking everything. Also, definitely started eating out way more.

journal.answer: Will see:)

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: First day was surreal, seeing soo many people. Kinda excited and anxious to see the college, meet my roommate, batchmates - all the friendly freshers. I remember the first night (my roommate wasn't there), I was woken up by a firecracker in the middle of the night. Kinda startling.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Its hard to pinpoint any one there are so many over the years to choose from. It would be the Pilan in 2-1, planned with my best friends on a scale we couldn't think of because we didn't want to do a dinner and the plan messed up in the most poetic way possible and in the end we are doing dinner.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: The Campus walks, definitely, no matter what was going on. Everything was better with a walk. Whether the long route back from David's or a serious discussion or just blowing off steam after an intense COD session. The best activity on campus especially the route in the first sem.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I feel I have learnt a lot on how to function in society and definitely I have gone from being absolutely naive to somewhat knowing to manage life. Not everything is so serious in life. Not everything requires a to calculate every angle and aspect. Not everyone is your well wisher. Learnt to identify REAL ones from the rest and learnt to forgive and forget. Live and let Live!

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I don't know what the cards hold for me! Didn't expect college to turn out the way it did but I am glad it did.  I really don't see a point in running after LPA, I would rather collect every experience I can get. I can't imagine doing a corporate job all my life, I would rather chase something else. Curious to see what the world and future holds for me.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: That was the first and last time I felt "Wow the campus is pretty big. It'll take a while to explore all the buildings."\n\nIt did NOT "take a while".

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: The day we got shared cycles for everyone on campus for the first time, Siddharth and I spent the entire night tracking 2 of them down and racing around campus.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Friends would barge into my room with the very same question everyday, whether it be 2 AM or PM, "Timepass?". A message would pop up on the group chat seconds later. "Timepass @ 218", it'd say, converting our Bakul room for 2 into a 10 person sabha. I already miss that.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: I started saying yes to fun more often. Those little treks in Hyderabad, late night walks to Microsoft, and evenings spent playing Undercover will be my fondest uni memories forever.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Between one assignment deadline and the next, I often forgot how much I love CS. I wish to be doing something that rekindles this love ever so often.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer:
First day on campus... I met Arya Topale (funny enough... I thought he was a girl). Never imagined he’d become my future roommate and best friend. Made so many memories and fights with this idiot. 
From day one to the last, he’s always stood by me. 

Love you always :)

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: This campus gave me priceless friends and countless memories... late night walks with Saumya, hanging out with Mohak. \n\nBut the bestest will always be time with my bestest friend... pickleball in the lab, chaotic Clash Royale matches and watching random horror movies. Truly the best days of my life.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: I’ll miss my friends the most :) \nand those random study discussions on "Toppels", fights with Topale and judging everyone with Saumya and Archi. \nBut most of all... I’ll miss hanging out with my cutieees "Relive". They saw the real, unfiltered me and I made my best memories with them (Truly Relive)

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Biggest change since first year has been how people and I changed. I’ve seen the kindest hearts and the harshest sides... and somewhere along the way, I grew too. I learned to stand on my own, making decisions independently. I became more self-aware, understanding my emotions, strengths, limits and choosing the right people around me.\nThis journey made me more mature, helped me understand emotions better and shaped the way I see people, relationships and life... grateful for it all.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: What next? Probably completing research and leaving college as soon as possible. Hoping to buy my own scooter or bike soon. \n\nAnd most importantly... staying in touch with all my cutieees 💜

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: It was pretty cool! yuktahar was the first mess that i went to. Realising that my randomly allocated roommate was a Gujju and lived 5 mins away from where i lived in our hometown was quite a coincidence! And surprisingly, the walk from bakul to himalaya seemed way too long XD!

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: Loads! For instance, starting campus-wide Navratri celebrations and workshops, participating in external events, random late night movie parties, UNO, helping in organising Festival events...what not!

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Difficult to select the one thing! There's a range of stuff - JC, random late-night walks on ISB road, UNO sessions, impromptu dinner plannings, last-minute assignments! but the events stand out amongst all these things - from organising to being their part and dancing with batchmates!!

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Learnt to manage and handle stuff - problems mine and others. organise events, meetings, learn to take responsibility for what went right or wrong. Most of all, learnt to understand people and situations :)

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: Let's see! Currently the plan stands at pursuing a PhD, but I am up for anything more exciting and energising, out of the ordinary and delightful! Anything that's outside of the usual humdrum is something i am looking forward to :)

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: dropped luggage, set up the room and immediately went to amphi to meet all the friends i had talked to over the last month on the freshers group and shared numbers with so many people, the campus tour walk at the end of the day was very memorable, made me fall in love with campus and the canteen :p

journal.answer: it is a combination of so many small yet joyful moments, but if i had to pick one it was the day i got my internship in the first shortlist! i realized that day i made myself, my family and my friends proud. one of the happiest i have ever been in college :)

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: "ab firta hoon main London, Paris, New York, LA, San Francisco"... 9to5 on the weekdays for hopefully not too long, ghoomi ghoomi whenever i get the time! and get back to old hobbies - GAMING!!! living large maybe  !? "mere ko na ek bangla chahiye, race course aur golf course ke beech me. uske ander private talab bhi chahiye, aur uske ander waterproof machliyan honi chahiye" - iykyk :)

testimonials.text: sooguuu!! college bestie since week 1, definitely couldn’t have survived college without you. my go-to buddy for late-night campus walks. would miss our countless memories together like cr games before endsems, geoguesser in classes, shared gns trauma, and unhinged late night banters 😭. prolly the only person with similar taste in youtube and tech. travelling is fun with you and also a great photographer 📸 thanks for taking my photos.

Most genuinely caring and helpful friend I've ever met. Has been with me throughout these four years, rain or shine. Introduced me to english songs and jetlag (it's so legendary bro 😭). It's amazing how we've grown together, learning and teaching each other along the way. Always the trip/outing planner and photographer of the group. Never shies away from helping others and takes time to hear you out. Love our reels scrolling and gossip sessions. I'm glad meet you & miss you so much sooguuu 😭😭

Hello Soumil, let’s totally go to a desert, my treat, as soon as I get the money😂. You’re such a good friend and are always so fun to talk to. You were one of the people who helped me survive the blr chaos (hum itne baar social kyu gaye, hyd is so much better). We will have so much more fun in blr together, without drinking and non-veg obvi. All the best for your future endeavours!!!

Sooguu, have known you since the first sem. We became much closer due to Penta and E-Cell and of course Receding Hairlines. My cute socially active yet socially awkward friend lol. 
Always comes to room and stops me from watching anime lmao. But I wouldn't be having a profile pic without you lol. I will always come to you for tech, such an informed beast.
Genuine and modest person. Also love how you do random polls, compile lectures for everyone and lot of other altruistic stuff. 
I'm so happy you got GS quite early. We might have talked less but know that I'm just a call away. Proud of how much you have matured.

Sooogu, lambu you are an amazing, genuine, funny and most importantly caring guy. I am grateful to be your friend. You are very kind and good at heart, you define the bro code. tere sath har ek moment is peak fun. Love you so much. BLR we are coming !\nPS : Hosla Indhan Badla

Would ask how’s the weather up there, but the weather is always good with you around. The best Photographer, Fortnite or whatever gamer, story spammer, sky photo paglu there on campus. Really enjoyed working in Apex and got to know you better as well!! thanks for all the wonderful joy and fun you bring in campus! Saari photos ek drive mai daal denge colllege ke baad. My Go to laptop and phone recommendor! Will stay in touch! Aapki GS salary sabko pata hai ab:(! Atb for the future Mousil Tagup!

Hello Soulim bhaiii! one of the best photographers i've met, a very very humble, aproachable and helpful person and someone who i can always rely on for any work! Its been a great 4 years being in EC together - will never forget the all-nighter for InfoComm, AEC, and the happiness when our iot project detected the downtimes! one of the best apex seniors and note-takers, enthusiast for knowledge and great info-in-WA-status person! Stay the same always, wishing all the very best brooo!!

Apex, photographer, tall guy, and of c lab buddy!! One of the coolest guy to be around. One of the most "real" person in a fake world. Dont change bhai!! One of the most kind hearted and helpful guy i have ever met! Those random talks about shitty course, shitty research, those are the things I will miss the most. All the best for the future, milte rehna!

soguu, met you in penta, and had a lovely time with you ever since. tumhari photography skills toh hai hi, but you've been an amazing friend, and god, i'll miss you and your giraffe waali height. hyd-blr karte rahenge, aur trips pe bhi chalte hai plss. loads of love <3. \n*sigh* now there is no one worthy to use my head as an armrest

Soguuu. What a cute guy bro. I've enjoyed our many, many conversations with each other over the years. You're a very kind soul. Also very helpful! Stay Awesome and keep in touch :) \n(Thank you for caressing my dwindling hair all these years)\nAll the best for your future!

Soguuu :). Really nice knowing you, love your niche interests they are very cool. You do things with a level of professionalism which is remarkable. I love your photography skills (and thanks for your dslr too xd). Fellow gs buddy, always stay in touch. You are very sweet and fun to talk to!

Very very tall😭. Loved interacting with you in E-Cell (one of the few ppl I would talk to during E-Cell dinners😅). You have really amazing photography skills (love the pics you take) and also make really fun plans. You are a very honest, sensitive and kind hearted person from inside. Always stay like that. Hope I come blr for job and we have more fun together !!

Helloo Soumil!! College has really been so much fun with you. Fellow ECE survivor hehe :)\nYou're incredibly smart & sorted. Beyond that, a very genuine & kind person. I had a lot of fun with you in Bangalore!\nGenuinely love hanging out with you, milte rahengee !!

Loved spending the first 2 years figuring shit out in ECE with u .. u definitely made it a lot more fun. I’ve always loved how u capture memories and genuinely make people’s day better. Honestly, a champion guy. Have been friends with him since the beginning, and can say that he has been a constant support. Cheerful, talkative and a lovely guy overall. College would have been so much more difficult without him.

yo bro! had the best time with you in Blr ! enjoyed our waffle excursions, dinners, the movie outings , the 'fence-crossing' and  thoroughly grateful for the anchoring presence you had for me there ! cherished our lovely stay together, and happy to have got to known you/learn from you in those days ! \nStay happy , keep smiling ! Wishing you a brilliant career and a fantastic life ahead !

Soumil! The photographer + instagram influencer of the batch ;). Very cool, calm and friendly. Was fun being a part of penta and ecell along with you. Wishing you the very best for the future. Keep in touch!

If Soumil is in a WhatsApp group, you know it's going to be entertaining. Well idk what to say, because there is so much. Met you in the first week of college and did the stupid bc dance. Fhir we had a lot of good times in workspace. Helu Sogu! You are really, really, really sweet, and it has been fun to have you around. Be it Bakchod, Penta, or Mess. Stay the same! Wishing you the best.\n
A great guy and the best photographer. Genuinely fun to hang out with and a really nice person. College mein jo time spend nahi kar paye hope to cover that up in Bangalore. All the best!
The most cool and humble guy , very smart guy, my OSA TAship friend all the best man , wish you loads of success, health,joy in ur life ahead !! Cheers !!!

Bro idk how you ended up being my teammate for DASS, BTP and basically every other project — but glad it worked out that way. name: Srivarshitha Medarametla
tagline: Somewhere along the way, it all made sense

testimonials.text: Dear Varshitha, I am so glad we met. I honestly wouldn't have survived this campus without you. Though we don't have many photos together, the times we spent - long walks, trying new food, late night rants, impromptu impulsive decisions, and many more - are memories I'll never forget. I am looking forward to one more year of these. You are one the most genuine people I have met and hope you never change and stay exactly the way you are. I wish you all the best for everything ahead!

first thing that comes to my mind is night walks. We had a lot of fun and deep conversations as well 🤣. Bitching abt food, college, life subjects, talking abt dogs. I am grateful for all the things that have happened. Hope we stay in touch :)

I’ve thoroughly enjoyed all the conversations we’ve had. Sharing so many common interests made everything even more fun. Really glad you introduced me to so many new things, especially F1 🏎️. I’ve always admired your sincerity. Wishing you all the best for the future!

Hey Varshitha, You are one of the most hardworking people I met on campus, your dedication is truly next level whether its your healthy food choices, lifestyle to academics. I absolutely loved our basement sessions where we used to sit till day trying to figure out assignments, go for coffee and then walks.  Talking non-stop that we lost track of time. Wishing you all the best and hope you suceed in whichever path you choose!
i remember talking a lot to you in the first year. Some of the conversations we have had have stuck with me. i always appreciate that we can talk really openly when we do. Stay awesome!

Would really love to make some time and meet you in Blr someday <3.

journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: i had slept for 2 hours, and drank 4 cups of coffee. I had a goal to talk to everyone i could, and i did.

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: I think there are so many small things that build up this campus. Nothing in specific. Things in my lab, things in different pockets of this place. Graduation felt beautiful though, if i had to choose one. It is wonderful to see a cohort of people for all their growth, strength and love.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: friends being nearby, nilgiri road, the lab, and the library.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: Everything has changed since first year. My attitude towards life, my realm of possibilities, my attitude towards learning, my knowledge base.  I got a lot fitter, my CG higher (general markers:p), and struggling and stumbling about research has made the world open up so much more. I broke my leg towards the end of the second semester, and it taught me to be kind to myself, and work with my body. Friends taught me so much, to love,, to live. The biggest change is in the smallest things <3

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: donno :0 \nbeing happy hopefully

Hey, you are one of the sweetest guys I know, I find you really passionate and hard working, and I really like your Instagram song page, it's amazing, you've got a great voice, I hope u achieve all your dreams. ATB !!

chetaannnn.. Thank you for everything chetann.. Most purest soul I have met.. I enjoyed all the moments we have spent in these 4 years.. always been fun around you.. All the best chetannnn!

you’re such a talented singer, and I genuinely admire how curious and interested you are in learning new things. journal.question: First day on campus?
journal.answer: On the first day, I felt both nervous and excited. I had many known ones with me (mainly Abhinav, coz we had decided ki roommate banenge and met before too). Overall, it was a great day, met a lot of people who'll be remembered for the rest of my life. Still can't believe its been 4 years since then

journal.question: Best campus memory?
journal.answer: The list is endless tbh. To summarise a few: meeting the ones that'll be remembered throughout, getting an intern, followed by a PPO, Dahi Handi :P, early morning niloufer and chutiya cricket; late night mafia, codm, poker. 300 words are too few to even summarise everything done over the last 4 yrs.

journal.question: One thing that I will miss the most?
journal.answer: Definitely not a single one. Performing at so many events, playing late-night games, mafia, our own version of cricket, turf outings, conducting CLC events, and going on late-night campus walks with loved ones. None of these can ever be recreated. 4 years were just THE perfect 4 years of life.

journal.question: Biggest change since first year?
journal.answer: When I came to college, I was extremely introverted, a person who rarely participates in events (especially dance coz shy). Over the last 4 years, this has completely flipped. Participated in so many dance events with friends, made a lot of friends, definitely became somewhat more extroverted, and conducted many events on campus. Rather than being self-centered, I became more flexible to face the real world and to accept the fact that, every time, things won't be like you want them to be.

journal.question: What next?
journal.answer: I'll be joining Schrodinger as a Software Developer. Apart from the careers that we all will be pursuing, I wish that every close one stays in touch. Things won't be the same as they were during the last 4 years. Everyone will be busy with their own set of problems and different goals. Staying in touch will become difficult, but one of the biggest goals of my life will be achieved if the closest of the people I met during my college push these limits and still manage to meet at least once a year
